on_screen_text.text: Rep. Frost on joining Team Biden-Harris

It's important that Gen Z elect Biden-Harris in 2024 because we need to protect democracy and they are actually listening to young people. I mean, look at this week — the American Climate Corps, the Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Great work going on right now because they are listening to young people. So keep organizing. Let's vote and let's win.

spoken_summary: Representative Maxwell Frost states that it's important for Gen Z to elect the Biden-Harris ticket in 2024 to protect democracy. He argues the administration listens to young people, citing the creation of the American Climate Corps and the Office of Gun Violence Prevention as examples. He concludes with a call to action for young people to keep organizing and vote.

central_claim: Gen Z should elect the Biden-Harris ticket because the administration is actively addressing their key issues and their re-election is crucial for protecting democracy.
intended_effect: To persuade young voters (Gen Z) to support the Biden-Harris campaign and feel motivated to organize and vote.
